LESSON: PLANTS AND ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment
Topic 1.4: Plants and its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Plants and its resources
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Plants and its resources

Teach
• Observe Plants and its resources in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Plants and its resources (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Plants and its resources.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Plants and its resources.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Plants and its resources.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Plants and its resources.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Plants and its resources: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
